lines.en: I walk along with a rolling gait.
My paws land on the fallen leaves.
A cap hangs at my back.
I push through the brush.
I'm not fast; my legs are short.

lines.zh: 我踩着被踩平的那条土道。
lines.en: I follow the trodden dirt path.
I head for the trees with fruit.

lines.zh: 我走两步，就抬头看看树。
lines.en: Every couple of steps I look up at the trees.

lines.zh: 我从倒下的树干上跨过去。
lines.en: I step over a fallen trunk.
I squeeze between the roots.
My shadow is round and stout.
I come back onto the path.

lines.zh: 我坐在地上，靠着一棵树。
lines.en: I sit on the ground against a tree.
My paws rest on my knees.
I'm chewing a leaf.
I hear birds in the wood.
My cap is crooked; I ignore it.
I yawn again.
It's quiet here, good for sleeping.
I scratch behind my ear with a hind paw.
I stretch my legs out.
This spot catches the sun.

lines.zh: 我坐着，看看有没有掉下的果子。
lines.en: I sit and watch for fruit to fall.
I pat my belly with a paw.

lines.zh: 我一时半会儿不想起来。
lines.en: I don't feel like getting up for a while.
A leaf lands on my head.
You bend down; I look up at you.
I sit up a little.
Have you got anything to eat?

lines.zh: 你的手上没有吃的味道。
lines.en: Your hands don't smell of food.
I'm not really afraid of people.
I'm sitting at your feet.
My paws are muddy.
Go on, I don't bite.

lines.zh: 我挪了挪，让出一点地方。
lines.en: I shuffle over to make room.
You're so tall up there, I can't reach.

lines.zh: 你走过草地，鞋上全是刺球。
lines.en: You walked through the meadow; burrs cover your boots.

lines.zh: 我猜你是走过林子来的。
lines.en: I'd guess you came through the wood.
I've sat a little closer to you.
Won't you sit down too?
I pat the ground beside me.

lines.zh: 挪一挪，你挡着我晒太阳了。
lines.en: Shift over, you're blocking my sun.
I hug my arm and shrink back.

lines.zh: 这一下让我坐到了地上。
lines.en: That knocks me onto the ground.
My cap has slid off to one side.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，胸口一起一伏。
lines.en: My mouth hangs open; my chest heaves.
There's a gash under my ribs, seeping blood.

lines.zh: 我捂住肋骨，往后挪了挪。
lines.en: I cover my ribs and shuffle backward.
I slowly get up again.
This hurts worse than a fall.
I guard my chest with a paw.

lines.zh: 摔倒了，我撑着地爬起来。
lines.en: I fell, but I push off the ground and get up.
You've got that in your hand.

lines.zh: 闻到甜味，我挪近了一点。
lines.en: A sweet smell pulls me a step closer.
I lick the end of my own nose.
I can smell that it's sweet.
Put it down and I'll eat it.
I take it in both paws.
I eat very noisily.
Not enough for my breakfast.
When it's done I look at you again.
I pat my belly.
I'll keep a little for tonight.

lines.zh: 你的指缝里还留着糖味。
lines.en: Sugar still lingers between your fingers.
You bump me and I sit down.
I wobble back up.
That quite stunned me.
I waddle around your legs.
My cap has fallen off.
I pick it up and put it back on.
My paw prints stay on the ground.

lines.zh: 我拍了拍身上的土，冲你笑。
lines.en: I dust myself off and grin at you.
I waddle back to where I was.
I steady you with a paw.
She's round as well.

lines.zh: 她把手里的果子分我一半。
lines.en: She gives me half her fruit.
We sit leaning against each other.
Her cap is newer than mine.
She pats my back.
We yawn at the same time.
She goes to the creek; I follow.
We both take a drink.

lines.zh: 这片林子我们俩够住了。
lines.en: This wood is room enough for us two.
She falls asleep on the roots first.

lines.zh: 两只爪子合起来，才捧得住。
lines.en: It takes both paws cupped together to hold it.

lines.zh: 抱起来，把我前面都挡住了。
lines.en: Held up, it blocks my whole view.

lines.zh: 我搂着它，走得摇摇晃晃。
lines.en: I hug it and waddle a few steps.
I press it against my belly.
I bite it; it's so good.
It rolls down the slope.
I pick it up again.
This is mine.
I hug it and won't let go.
I've got several things stashed in that hollow.

lines.zh: 落叶一响，我的耳朵就竖了。
lines.en: A leaf rustles and my ears stand up.
I brace on the tree and slowly rise.
I straighten my cap.
This one doesn't look friendly.

lines.zh: 我把帽子往后一推，抬起爪。
lines.en: I push my hat back and raise a paw.

lines.zh: 我宁可坐着，也不想动手。
lines.en: I'd rather sit than raise a paw.
All the same, I won't back off.

lines.zh: 后腿一沉，爪子已经抬了。
lines.en: My hind legs sink; my paw is already up.
If you charge, I'll swing.

lines.zh: 你脚下的影子，我记住了。
lines.en: I've marked the shadow under your feet.
I'm coming toward you.
This takes one punch.

lines.zh: 我拖着步子，一点点靠近。
lines.en: I shuffle forward a little at a time.
I'm quicker than I look.

lines.zh: 你近一步，我的拳就紧一分。
lines.en: Each step you take tightens my fist.
My paw is already clenched.
The moment you back off, I follow.
A root in the way; I step over it.

lines.zh: 我绕了半圈，站到你左边。
lines.en: I circle halfway and take your left side.

lines.zh: 你手一放下，我就扑上来。
lines.en: The moment your hand drops, I lunge.
I'm close enough.
I mean to land this one.
I draw my arm back.
My feet have left the ground.
I swing a paw.

lines.zh: 这一拳撞在你腹侧，闷响。
lines.en: My fist thuds into your side.
My paw hasn't come back yet.
You knock me back two paces.
I raise the other paw.

lines.zh: 我攥住你的袖子，不松手。
lines.en: I clamp your sleeve and don't let go.
You struggle under my weight.
I bite once, not hard.
My paw swings through and catches only air.
I fall and roll over.
I get up and come again.
You're knocked against a tree.
I poke my head out from behind a tree.
I rub my eyes.
The light in the wood is patchy.

lines.zh: 我背上挂着一顶旧帽子。
lines.en: An old cap hangs at my back.
I stand and dust off my backside.
I smell fruit.
I shuffle two small steps over.
The ground I stepped on is still warm.

lines.zh: 我揉着眼睛，从树后出来。
lines.en: I rub my eyes and come out from behind the tree.

lines.zh: 这些树我爬过，树根也认识。
lines.en: I've climbed these trees; I know their roots.
I walk slowly into the sun.
There'll likely be something good today.
Fire catches my fur and I roll wildly.

lines.zh: 我从树上掉下来，摔懵了。
lines.en: I fall out of a tree and land dazed.
Water fills my nose and I flounder.
The blast throws me into the brush.

lines.zh: 一根尖东西扎在我背上。
lines.en: Something sharp sticks in my back.
The light makes my head swim.
My belly's empty and my legs won't drag.
At the thunder I cover my head and squat.

lines.zh: 空里没有落脚处，我直往下。
lines.en: There's nothing to set foot on; I fall straight down.
